AUTHOR: Ottaviani
TITLE: Assessing the Image Concept Drift at the OBSEA Coastal Underwater Cabled Observatory
REGION: OBSEA cabled observatory, 4 km off Vilanova i la Geltrú, Catalonia, Spain (NW Mediterranean)
SPECIES: 14 classes with >200 individuals: Diplodus vulgaris, D. sargus, D. puntazzo, D. cervinus, Oblada melanura, Dentex dentex, Sarpa salpa, Spondyliosoma cantharus, Spicara maena, Chromis chromis, Symphodus mediterraneus, Coris julis, Serranus cabrilla, Apogonidae (30 species annotated in total)
DATA: Own OBSEA observatory still images: 14,025 images (one every 30 min, Jan–Dec 2014), 62,038 annotated individuals (29,497 to species)
V_EV: Study Area p.2: 'acquisition conditions characterised by turbid water and biofouling'; observatory 'located at 20 m depth' — no quantitative visibility and no visibility-stratified results (V6 NR)
D2: Exp 2/3: 30% of Jan-Apr individuals for training; remaining images (rest of Jan-Apr + May-Dec) tested monthly. Exp 1: random 50/50
D_EV: Methods: 'the 30% of the individuals were randomly sampled from the first four months of the one-year image set ... The remaining images were used to test ... on a monthly basis'
R_EV: Results Exp 2: 'A sensible drop of classification performance occurred in December ... a new camera with a different colour balance mechanism substituted the old one'
E_EV: Results: 'The overall accuracy is 93.7% and only 4 classes (i.e., f3, f9, f11 and f17) have an FNR larger than 20%'; Exp 3 'produced an average recall equal to 72.6%' — detection/classification metrics only
ARCH: ResNet18 (ImageNet-pretrained, only final FC layers fine-tuned) for species classification; Faster R-CNN for single-class fish detection
METR: Confusion matrix, accuracy, recall (TPR), FNR, precision, FDR; monthly accuracy (classification) and monthly recall (detection, IoU-based)
NOTE: Detection and classification are evaluated as separate experiments on the same image set (TYPE coded as 파이프라인(복합); Fig. 9 pipeline is proposed, not implemented). D1 = 조사일 reflects the time-ordered train (first 4 months) / test (remaining months) design of Exp 2–3; note that training crops were randomly sampled within the first four months so the remaining 70% of those months are also tested (possible same-image leakage), and Exp 1 is a purely random 50/50 split. R2 = 복수: temporal/seasonal drift plus camera replacement on 11 Dec 2014. V2/V3/V4 = Y assume these denote depth (20 m), illumination (LED lights, night images) and camera-to-subject range (3.5 m). Fish far from camera and overlapping fish excluded from training. Manual count time series provided as supplementary but AI output is not linked to abundance (E1 = 없음). Images available from OBSEA on request.
